class.name: SteamPurchases
class.brief_description: Starts and refreshes Steam orders through the game's authenticated purchasing backend.
class.description: Use [method SteamScope.purchases] after binding a [SteamCommerceBackend]. A local observer times out after 20 seconds. On timeout, retry the same cart and checkout ID so the backend can reconcile the existing order.

method.name: catalog
method.description: Await a [SteamPurchaseCatalogResult] for the signed-in player's offers.

method.name: checkout
method.description: Await a [SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult] for this cart. A pending receipt can be refreshed later by order ID. A failed local observation retains the checkout ID.

method.name: order
method.description: Await a [SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult] for the authenticated player's exact previously created order.

signal.name: order_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the authenticated game backend first reports or changes an order state.
